V66-0 #1 (moves a grade): R-TELEPORT O-HOLD is now LEFT-IF {H-GJW-COUNTERPART, H-ADS-TFD, H-COUPLED} for a hold on GJW alone. GJW was re-read at pp.12-15: the bridge is 'slightly traversable' (p.12), 'only open for a small proper time' (p.13), and the window is 'just enough to let the single qubit Q pass through' (p.15). The held throat comes from Maldacena & Qi 1804.00491, READ via alphaXiv: REMOVED-IF {H-GJW-COUNTERPART, H-MQ-NADS2, H-MQ-ETERNAL-COUPLING, H-MQ-LARGE-N} in nearly-AdS2, which is outside the board's setting.

V66-1 #2 (moves a grade): N_GJWAMB is replaced by what Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 1807.04726 shows (READ via alphaXiv). It realises a held throat in one space: REMOVED-IF {H-GJW-COUNTERPART, H-MMP, H-SM-FIELDS}, but only at sub-electroweak scale. For a throat that admits the payload the grade is LEFT-IF {H-MMP, H-SM-FIELDS}. The new throatbits.mmp_scales computes why: MMP's binding energy equals the payload's rest energy only at r_e ~1e-46 to 1e-48 m, below l_P; at r_fit the throat would need N_f >= 1.4-1.8e14 massless charged species and mouths more than 1e7 x the electroweak length apart. Outside MMP's family the hold is OPEN via the new pathway N_GJW-PAYLOAD (N_GJWPAY in combine66).

V66-1 #1 (moves a grade): M's ruling M-S1A-P3 ('a singular throat is not disqualified'; 'the throat-creation classes stay OPEN') is now applied as a board ruling. A1's throat-support O-MAKE-TOPO is OPEN via N_WNCC, computed by a new z3 item with 2 mutation controls; the ledger text is read at run time. In combine66, DEF-TOPO now covers every D66 geometric throat (DTHR, TBHOLO, TBTSH, TBTEL). Wave 1's encoding is kept as the reading singok-a2, which the drift guard catches as a mutation. A2's R-TELEPORT O-MAKE-TOPO without ITE is now OPEN via W-create-ncc.

V66-1 #3 (moves a grade): the wall seat PASSES under H-VIS-MINKOWSKI and O-LOOP is none. New defects.vis_time_function (sympy) shows Minkowski T is a global time function: the pullback is exact on both sides, g^(mu nu) dT dT = -1, T is continuous at the wall, and kappa sigma = 4 beta follows from the Israel jump (CGS p.15 and Fig.4 READ). N_WALLLOOP is retired; no wall-defeasible seat or removal remains.

V66-1 #4 (moves a grade): the global monopole is a TURN under H-TURN-CONJUGATE as well. New defects.monopole_conjugate integrates the Jacobi equation; its first zero falls at the axis recrossing to 6e-12 relative. Controls: with the curvature halved the zero misses the crossing, and A = 1 gives no crossing at all.

V66-1 #5 (moves a grade): the gauge monopole's lensing seat is S-1 IF {H-MONOPOLE-MASS, H-WEAK-FIELD, H-S1-VACUUM}, computed through spec.focal_length (new defects.gauge_monopole_lens). At 1e17 GeV a 1 AU focus needs b = 2.81e-13 m, with b/r_core = 3.6e18, b/r_s = 1.1e24, and field energy beyond b equal to 1.2e-19 of Mc^2. The result holds across the scan 1e15 to 1e19 GeV, and the 1e-27 kg control fails as it should.

V66-2 #1: the global monopole deficit is Delta = 8 pi G eta^2 exactly outside the core. New hedgehog_curved and monopole_deficit compute the hedgehog's stress in the cone metric. Wave 1's inconsistent flat-space input is kept as a control and gives the other value.

A paper/CLAIMS.md sentence DOCKET 66 contradicts (the paper is not edited): CLAIMS.md:1630-1631 reads 'Gott needs two passing with γδ₀ > 2, i.e. γ > 1.33e5 at the bound Gμ ≲ 6e−7'. A1 READ the Planck 2013 XXV bound, Gμ/c² < 1.5e-7 (Nambu-Goto, Planck+WP; 3.2e-7 for Abelian-Higgs), which gives γ > 5.3e5. The paper's 6e-7 is looser than the READ limit; the formula itself agrees (1/sin(4π·6e-7) = 1.33e5). As V66-2 #2 READ it, their result is narrower: a Gott pair cannot be created in an open (2+1)-dimensional universe with timelike total momentum. Worth comparing; I found no other CLAIMS.md sentence that DOCKET 66 contradicts.
